description: Implementation of InputFileManager class for managing file loading, including synchronous and asynchronous loading, with thread safety mechanisms, file parsing, and callback handling.

classes.name: InputFileManager::InputFileData
classes.description: Holds data related to an input file, including its tokens, parse tree, load status, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: InvokeFileLoadCallback
methods.description: Calls the provided callback with the parse node.

methods.name: DoLoadFile
methods.description: Performs the actual file loading, including reading, tokenizing, and parsing, with error handling.

methods.name: InputFileManager::InputFileData::InputFileData
methods.description: Constructor initializing InputFileData with a filename.

methods.name: InputFileManager::AsyncLoadFile
methods.description: Schedules asynchronous loading of a file with callback invocation upon completion.

methods.name: InputFileManager::SyncLoadFile
methods.description: Performs synchronous loading of a file, blocking until completion, with error handling.

methods.name: InputFileManager::AddDynamicInput
methods.description: Adds a dynamic input file with associated pointers for tokens and parse tree.

methods.name: InputFileManager::GetInputFileCount
methods.description: Returns the number of input files currently managed.

methods.name: InputFileManager::AddAllPhysicalInputFileNamesToVectorSetSorter
methods.description: Adds all physical input file names to a sorter for further processing.

methods.name: InputFileManager::BackgroundLoadFile
methods.description: Loads a file in the background, used internally by async operations.

methods.name: InputFileManager::LoadFile
methods.description: Loads a file synchronously, parsing and tokenizing, with error handling and callback invocation.
